# FLOAT16_MAX_NTH_FACTORIAL

> Maximum nth [factorial][factorial] when stored in [half-precision floating-point][half-precision-floating-point-format] format.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var FLOAT16_MAX_NTH_FACTORIAL = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/max-nth-factorial' );
```

#### FLOAT16_MAX_NTH_FACTORIAL

The maximum nth [factorial][factorial] when stored in [half-precision floating-point][half-precision-floating-point-format] format.

```javascript
var bool = ( FLOAT16_MAX_NTH_FACTORIAL === 10 );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var FLOAT16_MAX_NTH_FACTORIAL = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/max-nth-factorial' );

function factorial( n ) {
    var a;
    var i;

    a = 1;
    for ( i = 2; i <= n; i++ ) {
        a *= i;
    }
    return a;
}

var v;
var i;
for ( i = 0; i < 50; i++ ) {
    v = factorial( i );
    if ( i > FLOAT16_MAX_NTH_FACTORIAL ) {
        console.log( 'Overflow: %d', v );
    } else {
        console.log( 'Valid:    %d', v );
    }
}
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
